description: This file provides an abstraction layer over EC cryptographic operations using mbedtls within the libwebsockets library. It includes definitions and implementations for elliptic curve key generation, importing, and ECDSA/ECDH operations including signing, verification, key creation, and shared secret computation.

methods.description: Initializes a context for EC operations with specified curve table for ECDH.

methods.description: Initializes a context for EC operations with specified curve table for ECDSA.

methods.description: Sets the EC key for ECDSA operations using provided key elements.

methods.description: Generates a new EC keypair for ECDSA with specified curve and populates key elements.

methods.description: Computes a shared secret using ECDH.
